title: Exit Strategy
author: Martha Wells
summary: The fourth Murderbot novella. The self-aware security android, who has been dodging a corporation and trying to piece itself together, must act to help the humans who trust it. It draws the first run of stories to a close.
readIf: you've followed the series and want a satisfying, action-packed conclusion to its first arc.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier novellas, since this builds directly on them.

pairings.reason: Another story about an unlikely friendship and problem-solving in space, with a bigger heart and more scientific puzzles.
A cozy-to-bittersweet found-family space book if you want more about outsiders finding belonging.
A faster, grittier space story with a crew caught up in corporate and political schemes.
